sentences.en: The children started bouncing up and down on the couch.
sentences.zh: 孩子们开始在沙发上蹦蹦跳跳。

sentences.en: Sami sent Layla many letters but they kept bouncing back from Egypt.
sentences.zh: 萨米给莱拉寄了很多信件，但都被埃及退了回来。

sentences.en: The kids were screaming and bouncing everywhere.
sentences.zh: 孩子们尖叫着到处蹦跶。

senses.zh: 精力充沛的,精神饱满的,活泼的vt.“bounce”的现在分词
